task.prompt:
Your task is to write a single PostgreSQL stored procedure by completing the attached template.sql using the attached slots.md. The procedure applies caller-supplied values to records in the database as specified by the template and slot dictionary.

The procedure signature is exactly:

sp(para_DNO integer, para_DPhone integer, para_Division text, para_Appt_Type text)

Fill in every placeholder in the attached template.sql according to the matching entry in the attached slots.md. Do not alter the template structure: no statement may be added, removed, or reordered, and the code outside the placeholders must stay exactly as it is. The slot dictionary defines every placeholder.

Return only the complete stored procedure, with no additional text or explanation.

materials.text: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp(para_DNO integer, para_DPhone integer, para_Division text, para_Appt_Type text) LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE ref_cursor1 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM "Minor_in"; ref_cursor2 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM "Department"; rec1 RECORD; rec2 RECORD; new_facid integer; BEGIN OPEN ref_cursor1; LOOP FETCH ref_cursor1 INTO rec1; EXIT WHEN NOT FOUND; UPDATE "Minor_in" SET "DNO" = {SLOT_1} WHERE CURRENT OF ref_cursor1; END LOOP; CLOSE ref_cursor1; OPEN ref_cursor2; LOOP FETCH ref_cursor2 INTO rec2; EXIT WHEN NOT FOUND; IF {SLOT_2} THEN UPDATE "Department" SET "Division" = {SLOT_3} WHERE CURRENT OF ref_cursor2; END IF; END LOOP; CLOSE ref_cursor2; SELECT COALESCE(MAX("FacID"), 0) + 1 INTO new_facid FROM "Member_of"; INSERT INTO "Member_of" ("FacID", "Appt_Type") VALUES (new_facid, para_Appt_Type); UPDATE "Member_of" SET "DNO" = {SLOT_4} WHERE {SLOT_5}; END; $$;

ledger.answer: For a value slot, the cold-seal rule means the right-hand side must be the procedure parameter para_DNO exactly as supplied by the caller, with no transformation, no quoting, no arithmetic, and no column reference; the value is the integer argument supplied by the caller.
